ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The long-term impact of the crash will depend on the investigation's findings and any subsequent changes to aviation regulations or safety protocols. The incident may also affect public perception of air travel safety.
ai_analysis.operational_impact: The crash may cause disruptions to air travel and logistics on Catalina Island, potentially affecting the transportation of cargo and personnel. Airlines and logistics companies may need to reassess their safety procedures and protocols.
